name: Dify
description: Base module for integrating the Dify LLM-application platform with Drupal; provides a shared API client, markdown renderer, and server-side SSE chat/workflow proxy used by its submodules.

suggests.drupal/search_api: ^1.40 — Required by the Dify Search API submodule for knowledge base indexing.
suggests.league/commonmark: ^2.8 — Required by Dify Augmented Search and Dify Widget Vanilla for Markdown rendering.
suggests.league/html-to-markdown: ^5.1 — Required by Dify Search API for converting HTML field content to Markdown.

project_description: Official Drupal integration for the Dify AI platform. The base dify module ships no user-facing UI of its own: it provides a Guzzle-based DifyClient for the Dify Knowledge (Dataset) API, a CommonMark-backed MarkdownService with a shared render controller, and a DifyChatProxyService that streams Server-Sent-Events chat and workflow responses from Dify while keeping API tokens server-side. Feature work lives in four optional submodules: dify_search_api (a Search API backend that pushes Drupal content into a Dify knowledge base with automatic/parent-child/contextual-field chunking and optional Dify-Workflow file extraction), dify_widget_vanilla (a custom, fully themeable floating chatbot block that proxies the Dify Chat API), dify_widget_official (a block that embeds Dify's own hosted embed.min.js widget), and dify_augmented_search (a block that shows AI answers from a Dify Workflow next to normal search results). Credentials are stored in Drupal State (never exported with configuration), all outbound calls use TLS verification, and chat/workflow calls are proxied through the server so tokens are not exposed to the browser. Requires a running Dify instance (cloud or self-hosted), Drupal 10/11, and PHP 8.1+. There is no automated 1.x-to-2.x upgrade path.
